Callout.Name: Hit and Run
Callout.Message: Pedestrian struck, vehicle left the scene.
Callout.Advisory: Victim conscious in the road, vehicle described as a white van.

Script.Line: It was a white van and it did not slow down.
The pedestrian is in the road and he is talking.
The van went north. It went north and it was still accelerating.

Lines.Approach: White van gone, victim is in the road and conscious. Ambulance is on its way.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
